```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
from IPython.display import display, Markdown

df_curve = pd.read_csv("data/boc_implied_curve.csv")
df_probs = pd.read_csv("data/boc_probabilities.csv")
as_of = df_curve["as_of_date"].iloc[0]

next_mtg = df_curve.iloc[0]
current_rate = 2.25
next_change_bps = round((next_mtg['implied_rate'] - current_rate) * 100, 1)

display(Markdown(f"**As-of Settlement Date:** `{as_of}` | **Current Target Rate:** `2.25%` | **Next Decision Implied:** `{next_mtg['implied_rate']:.2f}%` ({next_change_bps:+} bps)"))
```

## Implied Policy Rate Path

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

df_curve['meeting_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df_curve['meeting_date'])

fig_curve = px.line(
    df_curve,
    x='meeting_date',
    y='implied_rate',
    markers=True,
    labels={'meeting_date': 'Fixed Announcement Date', 'implied_rate': 'Implied Overnight Rate (%)'},
    color_discrete_sequence=['#C8102E']
)
fig_curve.update_layout(
    template='plotly_white',
    height=420,
    hovermode='x unified',
    yaxis_tickformat='.2f'
)
fig_curve.update_traces(hovertemplate='Decision Date: %{x|%Y-%m-%d}<br>Expected Rate: %{y:.2f}%<extra></extra>')
fig_curve.show()
```

## Target Rate Probability Distribution

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

fig_probs = px.bar(
    df_probs,
    x="target_rate",
    y="probability",
    color="meeting_name",
    barmode="group",
    text="probability",
    labels={"target_rate": "Target Overnight Rate", "probability": "Probability (%)", "meeting_name": "BoC Announcement"},
    color_discrete_sequence=px.colors.qualitative.Dark24
)
fig_probs.update_traces(texttemplate='%{text:.1f}%', textposition='outside')
fig_probs.update_layout(
    yaxis_range=[0, 105],
    template="plotly_white",
    height=480,
    xaxis_title="Target Overnight Rate",
    yaxis_title="Probability (%)"
)
fig_probs.show()
```

### Probability Matrix

```{python}
#| echo: false

pivot_table = df_probs.pivot(index="target_rate", columns="meeting_name", values="probability").fillna(0.0)
pivot_table
```
